terra.problem: “He's not whispering it” assigns a speaking tone the text does not give.
“The twist he can't shake” asserts a continuing state of mind that the text does not state.
“He's not looking for more wisdom” asserts what the Teacher is not seeking. The text gives his question, not that conclusion about his intentions.
The lack of lasting remembrance does not establish that nobody celebrates or praises either person.
“I won't dress it up with a joke” comments on how Papa Dorin tells the passage.
“You've got a sunny heart” assumes something about the individual baker that Papa Dorin has not been told.
“Nobody takes it from him” adds a detail about the transfer that the passage does not establish.
“The comfort comes a little later” presents comfort as the Teacher's feeling, though the passage does not say he feels comfort.
“He doesn't say it softly” assigns a speaking tone that the text does not give.
The verse does not say that the man's work is over for the day.
“Gathering is the very thing that wore him down” assigns a cause the Teacher does not give.
